name: Music Quiz
author: PodBox
help: A track from your library plays from partway in. Turn the wheel to the right answer and press Select before the points drain away. Ten rounds, each harder than the last. Pausing loses the round you are in.

options.name: titles
options.title: Name the Track
options.help: Rounds that ask for the playing track's title

options.name: artists
options.title: Name the Artist
options.help: Rounds that ask who the playing track is by

options.name: albums
options.title: Name the Album
options.help: Rounds that ask which album the playing track is from

options.name: years
options.title: Name the Year
options.help: Rounds that ask the year the playing track came out. With every kind off, the quiz asks for titles
